fact: La Nation reports that the 23rd general assembly of ARTAO, held in Lome on the Friday before 26 April 2026, brought together the twelve ECOWAS member states, the Alliance of Sahel States and Mauritania.

Morocco's data protection commission (CNDP) and Mauritania's data protection authority (APD) signed a cooperation convention in Marrakech to exchange expertise and experience on personal data protection, after nearly two years of talks; the article is dated 2026-01-16 and says the signing was on a Wednesday, so the month is taken.
